text: あの　ヤドランが　いなければ　きを　きって　むこうに　いけるのに…　でも　どこか　まわりみち　すると　いける　らしい　けど…

structure.jp: あの　ヤドランが　いなければ
むこうに　いけるのに…
structure.en: I could get to the other side, but alas...

structure.jp: でも　どこか　まわりみち　すると
structure.en: but if you take a detour somewhere

structure.jp: いける　らしい　けど…
structure.en: apparently you can get there, though...

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば means 'if'; on a 'not' verb it becomes なければ, 'if not'. いなければ = 'if it weren't there'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end shows regret that things are not that way. いけるのに = 'I could go, if only...'

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい says this is something the speaker heard, not something he knows first-hand. いける らしい = 'apparently you can get there'.
